integrity: All mathematical identities are from the explicit covariance recurrence and accompanying reproducible computation; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric two-site dissipative generator; equal independent linear multiplicative Brownian noises; constant step; exact Lie--Trotter exponential; asymptotic mean-square only. Bibliographic comparison is not exhaustive and one older implicit-stability study was inaccessible.
title: A sharp mean-square stability frontier for positive two-site stochastic heat splitting
